planned_acceptance_checklist.acceptance: Bind approved final source, recorder, device/environment, fresh private profile, prepared real-data hashes and complete published inventory; release/source freeze cleared before recording.

Every current English scene covered exactly once by explicit real-app clips on one app base per lesson; real input, correct appearance, alpha only86/87, no bypasses; any recorder delta explicitly scoped.

Completed successful workflow and inspectable complete outputs; lesson-specific result checks. For20 retain raw accepted:false, fresh successful independent-reference verifier and hash-bound narrow filter/result acceptance.

Each selected native clip passes corrected unchanged numeric smoothness/pointer/top-bar limits. Retry once after failure. Near-miss only documented capture-loss condition >=27.0 with no freeze/slow/unknown/bypass/jump; preserve failure reports.

SHA-bind original native, handoff, frames, receipts, gates, telemetry, source inventory, selection and verifier evidence; reject duplicates/missing scenes, stale hashes and dialog-covered result views without scoped visual evidence.

Current English sentence/action/result review; source-bound changed-sentence translations with truthful review provenance and preserved exact reuses; no unsupported native/listening/scientific-accuracy claims.

All50 tracks/eight narration languages decode and match final narration/cache fingerprints; source-bound reuse when retained; onsets/sentence cues/native boundary clocks and0genuine footage-duration gaps checked.
Final silent4K30 master and web rendition fully decoded, byte-bound technical receipts, correct scenes/poster/timings; exact chosen footage remains inspectable after focus/zoom rendering.

All72 per-lesson browser/matrix commands succeed with exact media hashes:1English cues/boundaries,14master cases,50web voices+6web captions,1final reconciliation. Preserve all reports, not aggregate count alone.

Append/replace against latest verified immutable baseline without unintended lesson/catalog drift. Candidate validates routes/links/media/reviews and all84 ready playback identities; placeholders or withdrawals cannot count as completed demonstrations.
HF immutable commit+tag and all-byte readback match complete manifest; checked checkpoint/candidate/media browser proof retains truthful separate quality/publication scope; no upload while recording.

Actual channel Pages deploy succeeds, live index/source/deploy commit and immutable media root match; actual public84routes function after cache/deploy propagation. Local --published verification remains pre-deploy proof.

One84-row source-bound final ledger reconciles all lesson acceptance/staging/audio/browser/HF/deployment receipts and unresolved repairs before full goal completion. No invented hosted IDs or unmeasured quality claims.
